review_candidates.description_excerpt: We are seeking an Endpoint Management & Remediation Engineer to manage enterprise endpoint environments, drive vulnerability remediation, automate endpoint administration, and maintain security and compliance across Windows and mobile devices. The role requires strong expertise in Microsoft Intune, MECM/SCCM, PowerShell, Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, patch management, and application deployment. Primary Responsibilities Manage and configure enterprise Windows endpoints and mobile devices using Microsoft Intune (MDM) and MECM/SCCM. Plan and execute monthly security patching and endpoint remediation campaigns using MECM/SCCM.
